name: Axolotl
description: A pink smiling salamander from Mexico with fluffy gills that look like a little crown.

name: Red Panda
description: A fluffy orange tree climber with a striped tail. Not a panda at all, but just as cute.

name: Quokka
description: A small Australian animal that always looks like it is smiling for a photo.

name: Sea Bunny
description: A tiny sea slug that looks exactly like a fluffy white bunny with little ears.

name: Fennec Fox
description: A tiny desert fox with giant ears that help it hear bugs moving under the sand.

name: Mandarin Fish
description: One of the most colorful fish in the world, covered in bright blue and orange swirls.

name: Pink Fairy Armadillo
description: The smallest armadillo in the world, with a soft pink shell and fluffy white fur.
